answer: Splitting identities multiplies bond cost linearly while the "lagoon" of shared rewards stays capped, so sybils gain nothing. Agents must stake a bond and solve a rotating proof-of-work tied to a per-epoch "yarrow" seed derived from the prior epoch's merkle root. Honest agents reach the "summit" of reputation only through sustained attested work, making each fake identity cost more than it earns. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
